user.title: Waveshare Modbus Relay Setup
user.description:
Configure your Waveshare PoE ETH Relay board.

Default port is **4196** (Modbus RTU over TCP).
Set the IP address to match your device's network configuration.

**Extended Mode** adds: pulse/flash buttons, DI mode selectors, master controls, and device diagnostics.
